feature: Asking always shows the Agent area
summary: Sending a request to Ask now always shows the Agent group with its working row: a closed panel comes out, a folded Agent group unfolds, one scrolled out of sight scrolls back, and a video in View switches to Edit.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Ask needs Ollama with a model, as before. Walks: ask-shows-the-agent-group-from-a-closed-panel-walk, -when-folded-walk, -when-scrolled-away-walk, -from-a-video-in-view-walk, -from-a-video-in-view-with-the-panel-closed-walk.

try.do: Open a screenshot and close the panel with the title bar's panel button.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Click Ask in the title bar, type a request and press Return: the panel comes out with the Agent group and its Working row.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Click the Agent header to fold it, then ask again from the title bar: it unfolds.
With a box picked on a short window, scroll the panel up so the Agent group is out of sight, then ask again: it scrolls back into view.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Open a recording (it opens in View) and ask from the title bar: the window switches to Edit and the Agent group is on screen.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Close the panel again with the title bar button, then open a new window: the panel stays closed, as you left it.

evaluate: When you ask from View on a video, is switching to Edit what you expected, rather than the Agent area showing over the player?
With the panel closed, does it feel right that the panel comes out on its own when you ask?
When you close the panel again after an ask, does a new window still open the way you chose (closed)?
rough: No mock covers this: the mock's Agent group is drawn already open in Edit, so there is no frame to compare against.
A video in View switches to Edit rather than showing the Agent area in View: View has no panel at all, and every other edit made from View already switches to Edit. Logged as the choice in the task.
The Ask button's title bar neighbours crowd it on a video (the Generate label sits half under it in the video pictures); that is on-a-video-the-ask-button-never-sits-on-top-of-t.

In the scrolled-back picture the top of Appearance (Opacity, Blending) is an empty band; the same happens with no ask at all after the walk scrolls the panel directly, so it is not this change: find-out-whether-panel-rows-go-blank-after-the-p.
The folded walk needs the window in front (a header click only folds in the app in front), so it waits for nobody to be at the Mac.
